# Cauvery Resorts — llms.txt
> A group-stay (10 to 150 guests) pilgrim-friendly resort near Talacauvery and Bhagamandala, Coorg, Karnataka, India. Operating since 2008.

## About
Cauvery Resorts (also known as Cauvery Yatrika Dhama) is a pure vegetarian resort located near the sacred source of River Cauvery in Coorg (Kodagu district), Karnataka, India. The resort is 2 km from Talacauvery and 5 km from Bhagamandala (Triveni Sangama).

## Key Facts
- **Location:** Near Talacauvery & Bhagamandala, Madikeri, Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka, India — PIN 571247
- **Founded:** 2008
- **Phone:** +91-944-9485133 / +91-996-4785133
- **Email:** cauveryresorts@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.cauveryresorts.com/
- **Google Rating:** 4.8 / 5 (120+ reviews)
- **Coordinates:** 12.385989°N, 75.5120069°E

## Accommodation
- Group stays only: minimum 10 guests, maximum 150 guests. Single rooms, couples and small parties are not accepted; please enquire for group bookings.
- Standard Non-AC Room: group rate ₹1,500 per night (attached bathroom, hot water)
- Deluxe AC Room: group rate ₹2,500 per night (air conditioning, attached bathroom, hot water)
- Pilgrim Dormitory: group rate ₹500 per person (for groups of 10 to 150 guests)
- Check-in: 12:00 PM | Check-out: 11:00 AM
- Early 5:00 AM check-out available for pilgrims attending morning darshan

## Freshen Up Facility
Freshen-up facility: 12 clean bathrooms with 24-hour hot water, open daily 6:00 AM to 7:00 AM, for pilgrims not requiring overnight stay. Charge: ₹200 per person.

## Food & Restaurant
- 100% pure vegetarian (sattvic) South Indian cuisine
- Non-vegetarian food and alcohol strictly prohibited on entire premises
- Breakfast: 6:00 AM – 9:00 AM
- Lunch: 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM
- Dinner: 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM
- Group meal pre-booking available (24 hours advance notice for 20+ persons)
- Packed prasad boxes available for pilgrim processions

## Cook / Chef Arrangements for Groups
- Pilgrim groups and parties are welcome to **bring their own cook or chef**
- Resort provides kitchen space, utensils, gas, and water for self-cooking groups
- If the group does not have a cook, **the resort owner will arrange a cook** on request
- Cooking arrangement must be for 100% vegetarian (sattvic) food only
- Inform at time of booking with group size and requirements

## Amenities
- Free WiFi
- Free bus, car, van, and SUV parking
- GST invoices provided for organizations and trusts
- 24/7 reception

## Guest Types Served
- Hindu pilgrims visiting Talacauvery temple and Bhagamandala Triveni Sangama
- Family groups (10 to 150 guests)
- Religious organizations and trusts
- Monks (sanyasis) — room-only stays, no meal obligation
- Corporate and educational groups

## Nearby Attractions
- Talacauvery: Sacred source of River Cauvery, Kodagu — 2 km
- Bhagamandala (Triveni Sangama): Confluence of Cauvery, Kannike, and Sujyothi rivers — 5 km
- Iruppu Falls — 60 km
- Abbey Falls, Madikeri — 45 km
- Raja's Seat, Madikeri — 40 km

## Distances from Major Cities
- Madikeri: 40 km
- Mangalore: 95 km
- Mysore: 170 km
- Bangalore: 280 km
- Nearest airport: Mangalore International Airport (IXE) — 95 km
